scope: Exact probability statement/component map. A named statement is complete only when every stated mathematical component is covered; partial statements are not counted complete. All listed declarations are kernel-checked without proof escapes.

proved_components: Actual finite Borel measure uniqueness on [0,1] from all integer moments, and on [0,infinity) from integer Laplace samples.
Generic finite-Borel-measure Fourier uniqueness on the full real line.
Generic local MGF uniqueness for arbitrary finite real-line measures, proved by dominated holomorphic differentiation on a strip and the analytic identity theorem.

Native Gamma(2,1) measure equals the intrinsic density; normalization, no atoms, no negative mass, all factorial moments with integrability, full real Laplace domain s>-1, unrestricted full-real-line factorial-moment inverse deriving support, and Laplace inverse.
Actual full complex Laplace half-plane and complex Mellin integral formulas, actual characteristic function, mean two and variance two.
Direct unrestricted real-line characteristic inverse and logarithmic Mellin inverse for positive probabilities, using actual map log/map exp and the newly proved Fourier measure uniqueness.
Topological support is exactly the closed positive ray, expressed through positive mass of every open neighborhood.
All cumulants as actual iterated derivatives at zero of the native log MGF: kappa_(n+1)=2*n!.

Actual expected logarithm equals 1 minus the native Euler-Mascheroni constant, with log integrability, derived from native log-Gamma product limits and integral differentiation. Independently reviewed.
All integer exponential observations identify the actual Gamma probability among finite positive measures on all R; integrability, normalization and positive support are conclusions.
Explicit actual finite positive measure gammaProbability+dirac 0 retains every strictly positive-order factorial moment and is distinct, proving necessity of the zeroth moment.
unproved_components: Signed moment-null perturbations and finite-moment positive perturbations.

proved_components: Recurrence equivalence for actual native Poisson PMFs; integrability, mean one, full actual MGF and marked centered CGF; scalar reconstruction and algebraic KL/Bregman formulas.
Complete uncentered and marked-centered CGF neighborhood inverses among actual real-line probability laws; native Poisson integer support is a conclusion.
unproved_components: KL as actual relative-entropy integrals for Poisson/exponential/Gaussian laws; Legendre boundary supremums; variance, Fisher information and general Poisson tilts.

proved_components: Actual shifted Poisson measures have the same unmarked centered CGF and are distinct for every positive integer shift.
unproved_components: Actual relative-entropy reversal counterexamples for all three families.

proved_components: Full inverse from monotonicity alone plus marked 2-max, 3-max and anchor equations; exact dense-log-subgroup argument, canonical formula and all integer max laws.

Native Stieltjes probability, actual CDF and density measure equality, both endpoint limits, differentiability, and exact arbitrary probability-law inverse. Independently audited against all displayed P3 statements.
Multiplicative Haar measure on the positive ray, its logarithmic/exponential pushforward, scaling invariance, infinite endpoint mass, and the Haar-weighted Gamma density.
Exact marked-coordinate pushforward and pullback, pointwise density recovery on the positive ray, and explicit probability counterexamples for anchor removal and the base-two-only law.
Actual canonical potential has the stated two strict branches, endpoint divergence, paired roots and exact sublevel intervals.

Actual canonical deficit CDF on nonnegative and negative levels, no atom at zero; explicit canonical root pairing is a positive strictly decreasing involution, fixes exactly one, and preserves the potential and density.
The exact Lambert W0/W−1 root, CDF, and both canonical involution formulas, using semantically defined unique real inverse branches on the negative argument interval.
Actual derivatives of both inverse roots, and derivative of the actual deficit CDF equal to the exact displayed density expression, on every positive level.
unproved_components: Full smoothness of the involution and derivative at one; packaging the CDF derivative as an actual withDensity measure; square-root singular asymptotic.

proved_components: Actual canonical deficit pushforward probability on the nonnegative ray; exact full real MGF and exponential integrability for every s<1.
Sharp actual MGF integrability domain s<1, including divergence at and above one. Full-real-line moment determinacy from the actual target moments, deriving the candidate exponential envelope.

Standard algebraic cumulant recurrence determines the moment sequence; the deficit inverse follows when the target cumulant recurrence is calibrated. The explicit target calibration is not assumed proved.
unproved_components: Complete explicit cumulant list and CGF series, Gamma/polygamma/zeta/Euler evaluations, and the truncated transform.

proved_components: Actual linked pushforward probability data undo the positive density weighting and recover sublevel widths; common root pairing then determines both branches and the full potential, including the canonical Gamma target.
Literal positive-ray-only class wrapper derives measurability of the canonical extension and strict decrease of the linked root pairing; no global regularity or extra involution monotonicity premise.
Literal positive-ray inverse for the actual canonical target pair, with all target pairing properties and monotonicity derived; identifies both potential and density pointwise.
unproved_components: The alternative using the explicit zeta/Euler cumulant target values; actual law-and-involution inverse and exact Lambert target observations are proved.

proved_components: A measurable upper-branch source law has exactly the canonical deficit law under the fixed potential, but is distinct from the Gamma source law.
unproved_components: The noncanonical-potential countermodels preserving exactly the deficit law or exactly the involution.

proved_components: Actual Lebesgue tail integral and all survival/hazard/shift/potential formulas; hazard inverse in the differentiable subclass; logistic forward equation; exponential convolution integral and actual independent-exponential sum law at residual scale zero.
Global logistic inverse without a prior range restriction; actual sum of two independent unit exponential probabilities is Gamma.
Complete normalized second-order ODE inverse on the positive ray, with continuous zero boundary and actual mass integral, proved by integrating factors.
Actual native Gamma measure tail and interval probabilities equal the stated survival formulas.
unproved_components: Absolutely-continuous/a.e. hazard inverse, causal distributional Green uniqueness, and Poisson-process arrival-time construction.

proved_components: The actual atom-at-zero Gamma mixture is a probability supported on the nonnegative ray, with its atom, positive-ray density, actual survival, and derivative established. It retains the positive-argument hazard but changes the survival anchor and differs from Gamma.
The actual logarithmic pushforward has density exp(u)*p(exp(u)), the transformed survival and its derivative, and hazard exp(2u)/(1+exp(u)); it differs from the hazard composition for u nonzero.

The full self-survival shift equivalence for the native Gamma measure, for all positive shape, rate, and shift: shape one with arbitrary positive shift, or shape two with shift equal to the reciprocal rate. Both necessity and sufficiency are proved.
unproved_components: The continuous singular-survival counterexample with derivative zero almost everywhere in its singular factor, showing why local absolute continuity cannot be omitted.
Stieltjes integral formula and complete/open-interval inverse; complete monotonicity and non-Stieltjes boundary assertions.

proved_components: Actual normalized probability measure inverses for positive weights, marked exponential tilts, and positive size bias; reciprocal normalizer computed from observed law; exact Gamma size-bias inverse is the native exponential probability. Normalizers are actual nonnegative integrals, with positivity and finiteness explicit.
Actual normalized zero-atom exponential mixtures have the same Gamma size bias and differ from the positive exponential law.
unproved_components: Equilibrium-law inverse and its atom counterexample; Gamma tilt range, rate formula and cumulants; unmarked-rate counterexample; translate ENNReal normalizers to displayed real positive means.
Actual equilibrium fixed-point characterization without density assumptions on the input lifetime.
Actual rooted-series coefficients, convergence, Borel normalization/moments and inverse germ.
Native one-ancestor iid Galton-Watson total-size law and its offspring inverse.
Coefficient-mark, branch, and critical-tail counterexamples.

proved_components: Actual nonnegative Lebesgue relative-divergence integral, exact almost-everywhere equality case, and extended-real entropy bound/equality including infinite divergence, for any finite calibrated cross-entropy constant.
Actual candidate constraints imply finite cross entropy; the extended entropy definition agrees with the ordinary negative integral of f log f whenever finite.

Concrete Gamma target satisfies all calibrated constraints; actual entropy value 1+EulerGamma, extended maximum and exact equality inverse, and agreement with ordinary finite entropy. Every displayed theorem assertion is covered.
unproved_components: The additional smooth constraint-preserving perturbation counterexample in the proof prose.
Actual Gamma convolution semigroup existence and uniqueness from the time-one law, including all cumulants.

proved_components: Actual improper-integral identities for the Levy density as an exponential mixture and log(1+lambda) as its complete-Bernstein rational integral; exact exponent derivative.
Actual Levy-Khintchine scalar integral equals 2 log(1+lambda), with integrability and Fubini proved.
unproved_components: full complete monotonicity derivative package, subordinator Levy-Khintchine representation and all drift equivalences.

proved_components: Native compact Hausdorff uniqueness needed for the integer-tail reduction.
unproved_components: Bernstein representation and endpoint masses; see final:O6 operator map.

proved_components: Actual nonnegative residual distribution, exact transform and zero atom, actual independent Gamma self-decomposition.
unproved_components: Compound-Poisson/Levy realization, total jump intensity, infinite divisibility and full Gamma-family nonidentification examples.

proved_components: Full actual law equivalence between Gamma and the explicitly constructed independent residual decomposition for arbitrary probabilities on R, deriving support without source moments; exact characteristic-equation rigidity to the rational canonical function; residual scale recovery from atom c²; characteristic endpoint obstruction.
Actual Fourier integrals of native Gamma and explicit residual probabilities; independent-law clause implies the exact characteristic equation, and the canonical Gamma law satisfies it.
Actual residual at c=1 is dirac 0 and every probability law satisfies the corresponding independent decomposition.

Generic finite-measure Fourier uniqueness on all R proved from native compact-circle Fourier density and expanding-period decoders; complete three-way P9 equivalence and explicit unlinked-designation counterexample.
